purpose: Teach: 乗り入れ/交わさ/晒し/臆病/上等/物凄い/隅々/善良

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新バスがメイ姉さんのお家まで乗り入れされるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I heard a new bus route is going to come right to my house now.
lines.style: Warm and pleased. Bright delivery with a gentle lift at the end. Speaking to a child she cares about, sharing something that delights her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと毎日言葉を交わさないと淋しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I get lonely if I don't talk to Dad every single day.
lines.style: Small, quiet voice. Sincere without performing sadness. A simple fact he needs her to understand. Slight hesitation before admitting it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが干物を晒して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to hang-dry some fish for us.
lines.style: Tender observation. Warm tone, like she's noticing something kind about him and sharing it gently. Calm pace. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お化けに臆病なんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm actually kind of scared of ghosts.
lines.style: Quiet confession with an undertone of self-awareness. Not seeking reassurance, just stating it plainly. A small boy trusting her with a small truth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが上等のお肉を買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad picked up some really nice meat for us.
lines.style: Pleased and matter-of-fact. Noticing the kindness in small actions. Warm but not overstated. The tone of someone who appreciates being looked after.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの腕力って物凄いよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad is so incredibly strong.
lines.style: Eager, genuine admiration in a child's voice. Bright and unselfconscious. The kind of praise that comes naturally when he's impressed by someone he loves.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋の隅々まで一緒に掃除しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's clean every corner of the room together, okay?
lines.style: Inviting and gentle. An inclusive suggestion, not a directive. Warm tone that makes it sound like something they'll do together as a team. Slight rise at the end, a soft question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんは善良な方だと尊敬してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really respect Dad. He's a good person.
lines.style: Steady, sincere voice. No performance or shyness about the emotion. Spoken with the quiet certainty of a child who has watched and decided. Soft but clear.
